content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> P1 | az13 serving cluster queue depth spike > 4k for 10m. Automatic prefailover evaluation started. @maria you are primary oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Incident: P1 az13 queue-throttle. Paging: maria, leo, ken. Link: https://pd.example/INC-1799992468 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): ack

maria (oncall): seeing 5xxs for a subset of customers, and tail latency up from 120ms -> 1.6s on az13. Confirming impact window and whether this is autoscale/backpressure related.

leo (eng-sre): I'm seeing continuous queue backlog on the az13 frontends. evict rate jumping, node CPU 98% on several pods. logs show repeated KV cache rehydrate failures.

ken (eng-runtime): grabbing model-serving metrics. Throughput per shard dropped, token generation latency skyrocketing when seq > 512. Probable batching/queue pileup.

sara (support): triage note: two enterprise customers reported timeouts and API 503s starting ~00:34 UTC.

maria (oncall): ok plan: 1) enable regional fallback routing for az13 -> az2/az5 for new requests, 2) scale Dedicated pool for az13 read capacity if possible, 3) rollback recent config if correlated. Who can flip fallback?

ken (eng-runtime): I can enable routing divert. Will apply routing policy "az13-prefailover-divert" with 60% divert to az2, 30% az5, 10% stay for affinity.

ken (eng-runtime): running command now:
```
# apply routing divert
redwoodctl routing modify --region az13 --policy prefailover-divert --weights az2=60,az5=30,az13=10
```

deploy-bot: routing change queued, will take ~20s to propagate.

leo (eng-sre): starting quick scale on az13 frontends (replica bump + node request). Running k8s scale.

leo (eng-sre): command:
```
kubectl -n serving-scale scale deployment/frontend-az13 --replicas=18
```

leo (eng-sre): also spinning a temporary GPU spill pool for model shards to relieve token backlog.

maria (oncall): pager update: ack by maria at 00:36 UTC. Escalation to ken for runtime mitigation. @alex FYI for customer comms.

alex (product-ops): noted. Drafting a short notification to affected customers, will include mitigation steps and ETA. Any estimate on recovery time?

ken (eng-runtime): after divert starts, tail latency should drop in ~1-2min for new requests. Backlogged requests may keep failing — we're dropping anything older than 30s at the router to avoid cascading retries.

sara (support): posting interim reply to customers: "We're routing requests around the impacted zone and working on additional capacity. We will update in 15 minutes." sending now.

maria (oncall): routing propagation confirmed. metrics: az13 new traffic down 65%, az2/az5 load up. 5xx rate trending down from 12% -> 3% over 2 mins.

ken (eng-runtime): enabling automatic KV-cache rehydrate backoff to reduce storm. patch applied to runtime config.

ken (eng-runtime): config snippet applied:
```
cache.rehydrate.backoff_ms = 200
cache.rehydrate.max_retries = 3
```

leo (eng-sre): after scale, node CPU normalized to ~65% on scaled replicas. Queue depth on az13 dropped from 4200 -> 700 in 6 mins.

incident-bot: Automated prefailover check: criteria met for controlled divert (latency > 1s, error > 5%). Failover flag NOT set. No full AZ evacuation.

maria (oncall): good. keep divert, monitor for 15 more minutes. ken/leo, please keep me posted if we need full fallback activation.

sara (support): customers updated at 00:50 UTC with mitigation and expected next update in 30m.

alex (product-ops): collecting impacted customer list for SRE to prioritize if we need targeted whitelisting to avoid coldstart.

ken (eng-runtime): noting root cause signal: elevated KV-store latency in az13 causing cache misses and heavy rehydrate storms, which amplified batching pressure. We'll open an RCA ticket after incident.

maria (oncall): escalation note: if error rate > 5% sustained for 10m, escalate to oncall-2 and consider cross-region weighted reassign and emergency capacity commit.

leo (eng-sre): adding temporary rate-limiter at ingress for az13 to protect control plane while we watch rehydrate. Config applied.

maria (oncall): last check (00:52 UTC): 5xx 2.1%, latency median 140ms, p95 320ms. Leaving divert in place. Starting incident timeline doc.

maria (oncall): closing pager for immediate handoff to post-incident queue. PD incident will remain open for RCA. Thanks all, good containment. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident status: acknowledged -> resolved (manual). Incident will remain for RCA.

ken (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) increase KV-store P95 SLO, 2) tune rehydrate backoff defaults, 3) evaluate autoscaler cooldowns for queue spikes.

alex (product-ops): I'll coordinate customer follow-up comms and schedule a short postmortem readout tomorrow.

sara (support): logging customer impact for billing/credits review.

maria (oncall): final note: create runbook action items and assign owners. i'll add to the incident doc.

maria (oncall): thread closed at 00:58 UTC for on-call handback.
